newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar drifts off lower as NY corrects.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar drifts off lower as NY corrects.

text.p: London white sugar futures followed the New York market lower as the raws staged a technical correction after surging to seven-week highs, traders said on Friday.
The two nearby months again dominated the heavy session volume in a combination of crosses and against actuals trades, with commission houses said to be prevalent.
But New York set the pace in the afternoon despite whites traders' eagerness to bale out of the spot May contract before expiry next Tuesday.
Traders said slacker demand for EU sugars should limit the physical delivery against May whites and also the chances of a squeeze on short positions.

"I think the whites are going through a bit of slump...at the moment, as you're not really shifting sugar, I think people are only taking off the bits and pieces of business that goes on every day," said one.
"Nobody is willing to take a big gamble. Everyone is a bit lethargic, I don't think the whites are going to have any real surprises," he said.
At 1620 GMT May was down $1.40 at $311.80 and August was 90 cents lower at $310.80. Volume reached 3,454 lots.
One trade house was said to have been a consistent buyer of May in the latter half the week, either through outright or spread dealings, leading to speculation of a higher physical delivery.
But market sources said slackening demand for EU sugar suggested that delivery was likely to be limted to two cargoes at most.
Trading in Paris was confined to the two nearby months in an overall volume of 523 lots.
May was down $2.30 at $312.20 and August down $1.50 at $310.50.
